turn_operation.instruction: Interpret what the listed observations may indicate. Do not explain an unauthorized cause, actor, time, or history. A bounded inference may be proposed as gm_inference, inferred, possible, or left in narration. Do not declare a new world fact merely to answer.

declaration_guidance.bounded_inference: propose only; provenance gm_inference; epistemic_status inferred; modality possible; relation_kind epistemic_status. Not authored_world_fact.
declaration_guidance.epistemic_premise: No player hypothesis, NPC claim, or unresolved premise is authorized on this turn.

answer_strategy: Answer the interpretation with one qualified possibility grounded in the required observations. Use could, may, or might, and keep the wording tied to those observations. Do not explain an unauthorized cause, actor, time, or history.
